notes.title: Torches of Fate Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hey! Letting everyone know we are doing a MASSIVE content update for Torches of Fate!  We will keep you posted as more details get fleshed out and worked on :D

-Adding a bunch of new unique weapons and armor as drops to several different common enemies.

-Redoing Death's Castle to have it be more in line with the previous dungeons, as well make it easier to navigate.

-Adding a new area for a new gameplay mode!  This area you will have special versions of Dimitri, Engore, Riley, and Ramona that you can build and improve as you climb the tower.  In this rougelike mode you will be able to spend stardust to increase your stats how you see fit.  Getting random weapons, armor, rings and items as you climb.  Be careful, if you perish you will be sent back to the bottom of the tower with just the stats you have leveled and the stardust you have earned!  This mode has all unique weapons and armor from the base game, as well as a special boss, and some new enemies!
